listenQuestion: What factor helped to spread the disease of myxomatosis?

lines.en: In the early days of the settlement of Australia, enterprising settlers unwisely introduced the European rabbit.
lines.zh: 在澳大利亚移民初期，一些有创业精神的移民不明智地把欧洲兔子引进了澳大利亚。

lines.en: This rabbit had no natural enemies in the Antipodes, so that it multiplied with that promiscuous abandon characteristic of rabbits.
lines.zh: 这种兔子在澳大利亚及新西兰没有天敌，因此便以兔子所特有的杂乱交配迅猛繁殖起来。

lines.en: It caused devastation by burrowing and by devouring the herbage which might have maintained millions of sheep and cattle.
lines.zh: 它们在地下打洞，吃掉本可以饲养数百万头牛羊的牧草，给澳洲大陆造成了毁灭性的破坏。

lines.en: Scientists discovered that this particular variety of rabbit (and apparently no other animal) was susceptible to a fatal virus disease, myxomatosis.
lines.zh: 科学家们发现，这种特殊品种的兔子（显然不包括别的动物）易患一种叫“多发性粘液瘤”的致命毒性疾病。

lines.en: By infecting animals and letting them loose in the burrows , local epidemics of this disease could be created.
lines.zh: 通过让染上此病的动物在洞内乱跑，就可以使这种疾病在一个地区蔓延起来。

lines.en: Later it was found that there was a type of mosquito which acted as the carrier of this disease and passed it on to the rabbits.
lines.zh: 后来又发现，有一种蚊子是传播这种疾病的媒介，能把此病传染给兔子。

lines.en: So while the rest of the world was trying to get rid of mosquitoes, Australia was encouraging this one.
lines.zh: 因此，世界上其他地方在设法消灭蚊子的时候，澳大利亚却在促使这种蚊子大量繁殖。

lines.en: It effectively spread the disease all over the continent and drastically reduced the rabbit population.
lines.zh: 蚊子把这种疾病扩散到整个澳洲大陆，效果甚佳，结果兔子的数目在为减少。

lines.en: It later became apparent that rabbits were developing a degree of resistance to this disease, so that the rabbit population was unlikely to be completely exterminated .
lines.zh: 后来，明显看出，兔子对这种疾病已产生了一定程度的免疫力，所以兔子不可能被完全消灭。

lines.en: There were hopes, however, that the problem of the rabbit would become manageable.
lines.zh: 但是，已有希望解决兔子所带来的问题。

lines.en: Ironically, Europe, which had bequeathed the rabbit as a pest to Australia, acquired this man-made disease as a pestilence .
lines.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，欧洲把这种兔子作为有害动物传给澳洲，而欧洲自己却染上了这种人为的瘟疫般的疾病。

lines.en: A French physician decided to get rid of the wild rabbits on his own estate and introduced myxomatosis.
lines.zh: 一位法国内科医生决定除掉自己庄园内的野兔子，于是引进了这种多发性粘液瘤疾病。

lines.en: It did not, however, remain within the confines of his estate.
lines.zh: 然而，这种疾病并未被局限在他的庄园内，结果在整个法国蔓延开来。

lines.en: It spread through France, Where wild rabbits are not generally regarded as a pest but as sport and a useful food supply, and it spread to Britain where wild rabbits are regarded as a pest but where domesticated rabbits, equally susceptible to the disease, are the basis of a profitable fur industry.
lines.zh: 野兔在法国一般不被当作有害动物，而被视为打猎取乐的玩物和有用的食物来源。这种疾病又蔓延到了英国。

lines.en: The question became one of whether Man could control the disease he had invented.
lines.zh: 在英国，野兔被当作有害的动物，可是家兔是赚钱的毛皮工业的基础，然而家兔同样易感染这种疾病。
现在的问题是，人类能否控制住这种人为的疾病。
